title: RNA becomes a drug class
subtitle: Selected U.S. FDA approvals and firsts, by modality. Hover or tap for details.

events.label: fomivirsen
events.detail: CMV retinitis. The first approved antisense drug, injected into the eye.

events.label: nusinersen
events.detail: Spinal muscular atrophy. Splice-switching: forces inclusion of exon 7 in SMN2. Delivered intrathecally.

events.label: eteplirsen
events.detail: Duchenne muscular dystrophy (exon 51 skipping); accelerated approval in 2016.

events.label: eplontersen
events.detail: Hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis polyneuropathy (2023); GalNAc-conjugated, given monthly.

events.label: patisiran
events.detail: Hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis (2018). The first approved siRNA, packaged in lipid nanoparticles.

events.label: givosiran
events.detail: Acute hepatic porphyria (2019). The first GalNAc-conjugated siRNA, injected under the skin.

events.label: inclisiran
events.detail: LDL cholesterol lowering by silencing PCSK9 (2021). Maintenance dosing twice a year.

events.label: fitusiran
events.detail: Hemophilia A or B prophylaxis by silencing antithrombin (2025).

events.label: COVID-19 vaccines
events.detail: Emergency use authorization in December 2020 for two modified-nucleoside mRNA vaccines; full approvals followed in 2021–2022.

events.label: RSV vaccine
events.detail: An mRNA vaccine against respiratory syncytial virus for older adults (2024).

events.label: exa-cel
events.detail: Sickle cell disease (2023). The first approved CRISPR therapy; cells are edited outside the body with a Cas9 guide RNA.

events.label: bespoke base editor
events.detail: A single infant with CPS1 deficiency is treated in vivo with an mRNA-encoded base editor and guide RNA in lipid nanoparticles (reported 2025). A case, not an approval.
